$comment: Single description of the MCP servers this kit registers. Consumed by skills/roblox-setup/scripts/mcp-config.sh (via the copy in skills/roblox-setup/assets/mcp-servers.json, kept in sync by `make sync-lib`) and mirrored by /.mcp.json. Placeholders: {studio_mcp_bin} and {blender_bin} are resolved on the target machine; a bare command is resolved to an absolute path when found. An env entry whose placeholder cannot be resolved is dropped.

Roblox_Studio.description: Roblox Studio's built-in MCP server: read and edit the open place, run Luau, play-test, generate assets

blender.description: Official Blender MCP server (Blender Lab) v1.0.3: inspect scenes, run Python, render previews; talks to the Blender add-on on localhost:9876
